ModMetaData.name: Android tiers
ModMetaData.author: Atlas, aRandomKiwi, CrackaJack, MushuIV
ModMetaData.description:
- Adds 5 tiers of autonomous mechanical colonists along with cybernetic animals - Fully integrated TX Series infiltration androids (TX2, TX2K, TX3, TX4 and infantry "I" variants) with craftable synthetic skin glands, surgical dermal grafting/stripping, human disguise, and EMP/solar flare immunity - 2 autonomous android factions (Civil Android Collective and Android Insurrection) - Remote control surrogate android avatars via SkyMind network - Digitize, upload, duplicate, and store colonist minds in centralized supercomputers - Mechanical-specific ailments, maintenance faults, and coolant failures - Deep cybernetic upgrade tree (replacement organs, specialized processors, nanite frameworks) - Full expansion compatibility: Royalty Empire exemptions, Ideology precept support, Biotech gene/toxin immunity and hemogen dermal gestation, Anomaly flesh-parasite immunity, and Odyssey vacuum sealing
Optional Integrations: - Questionable Ethics Enhanced (QEE): Enables cultivating synthetic skin glands in Organ Vats and growing living tissues over TX2K/TX3/TX4 frames in Clone Vats alongside native dermal grafting. - Enable Oversized Weapons: Enhanced rendering for M7/M8 mechanized heavy armaments.
Version <color=#FFD800>3.0.0 (RW 1.7)</color>
